summary: XORTX Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K to provide preliminary unaudited stockholders' equity of ~$4.1M, claiming continued compliance with Nasdaq's minimum equity listing standard. The filing references the April 13, 2026 closing of its acquisition of Vectus Biosystems' VB4-P5 asset, but this is a backward-looking disclosure, not a new strategic event. The report contains only forward-looking disclaimers and no actionable corporate transaction, tender, or restructuring. As a routine foreign-issuer status update absent a triggering special situation, no event is classified.
